test_title: PYST 1: SSC GD Constable - Reasoning (Held on: 16th November 2021 Shift 1)
subject: reasoning
question:
In the following Venn diagram, the circle represents ‘vegetables’, the triangle represents ‘roots’, the square represents ‘hard soil’, and the rectangle represents ‘summer’. Which of the following letters represents root vegetables that grow in summer but NOT in hard soil?

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e2ec9be0a02cb1c0278b88015999d90dd7ab7fbd20392a90cc6099121ebb03a.png]
solution:
The shaded part represents a set of letters representing root vegetables that grow in summer but NOT in hard soil.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c0f42345623d47929e4574c7ea085003ec7bd544ddc42220cee3259e0bf9eac4.png] 

The set of letters representing root vegetables that grow in summer but NOT in hard soil = D

Hence, ‘D’ is the correct answer.
